breakdown.description: The inward normal pressure on the arc is replaced by a fixed vertical traction vector
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly treats the arc load as an inward normal pressure using t = -p*n with n the outward unit normal of the solid, rather than as a fixed vertical traction vector (0, -20 kPa). This matches the ground truth's instruction to 'Treat the arc load as an inward pressure on the semicircular boundary, not as a vertical traction.'
